stories.title: Nitanshi Goel walks for Suneet Varma
stories.summary: Actress Nitanshi Goel served as the showstopper for Suneet Varma at Lakme Fashion Week 2026 in New Delhi. She wore an embellished fishtail lehenga from the designer’s Kashi collection, which the brand says is inspired by the city’s heritage, colours and craftsmanship. The spotlight was successfully stolen.

stories.title: FDCI promotes Indian textiles in Egypt
stories.summary: The Fashion Design Council of India is showcasing Indian textile heritage at Egypt Fashion Week with Rahul Singh’s SUTRA collection. The council aims to promote Indian designers internationally, following a Lakme Fashion Week event that featured global designers from Moscow and Italy. The craft is now travelling.

stories.title: Vogue India shoots in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.summary: Vogue India featured Arunachal Pradesh in its November-December 2026 issue, with photos taken at the Ziro Festival of Music. The shoot combined international luxury labels like Dior and Gucci with local designs. The magazine says the project brings together high fashion and Northeast traditions.

stories.title: TOI Fashion and Beauty Awards set for December
stories.summary: The Times of India Fashion and Beauty Awards will take place on December 20 in Mumbai. The event aims to honor independent labels, creators and influencers, as the organizers claim fashion is no longer limited to designer catwalks or dictated by established brands. The landscape is officially changing.

stories.title: The Bindi Project reports revenue growth
stories.summary: Meghna Khanna’s handcrafted jewellery business, The Bindi Project, recorded ₹20 lakh in revenue for FY25, doubling its previous year's earnings. The venture, which launched in 2022 following a ₹5 lakh investment, had served over 1,500 customers by October 2025. A grandmother’s gold bindi inspired the expansion.

stories.title: Frontier Raas opens Ahmedabad store
stories.summary: Frontier Raas has opened a new store in Ahmedabad, marking the 72-year-old brand's entry into the Gujarat market. Actor Kangana Ranaut inaugurated the space, which offers bridal couture and handloom saris. The brand says the expansion strengthens its presence in key domestic wedding and textile markets.

stories.title: Amit Aggarwal relaunches AM:IT line
stories.summary: Designer Amit Aggarwal has relaunched his prêt line, AM:IT, at Lakmé Fashion Week and opened a new flagship store in Mumbai. The designer has spent over a decade working with industrial materials and upcycled textiles. He notes that good design alone cannot build a fashion business.

stories.title: Vogue India Features Ziro Valley In First-Ever Arunachal Pradesh Fashion Shoot - Howl.Link
Swadesh and Mayyur Girotra collaborate
stories.summary: Swadesh and designer Mayyur Girotra have launched a collection featuring regional crafts including Kanjeevaram and Bandhani. The collaboration aims to explore how traditional textiles can fit into modern wardrobes. The brand claims the collection retains the individuality of each craft while adopting a contemporary design vocabulary.

stories.title: Florence Pugh wears Victorian mourning dress
stories.summary: Florence Pugh attended an East of Eden event in Los Angeles wearing a Victorian-inspired mourning dress designed by Harris Reed. The ensemble featured structured black satin and exaggerated shoulders. The actress paired the period-appropriate look with modern Vivienne Westwood pumps. The symmetry was described as almost perfect.

stories.title: Florence Pugh continues method dressing
stories.summary: Florence Pugh wore a Victorian-style mourning dress to an East of Eden event in Los Angeles. Designed by Harris Reed, the outfit featured high necklines and power shoulders. The style references the mourning customs popularized by Queen Victoria in 1861. The method dressing remains in effect.

stories.title: Emma Watson wears vintage Valentino
stories.summary: Emma Watson attended GQ’s Men of the Year party in Los Angeles wearing a vintage piece from Valentino’s 2016 resort collection. The actress, who has kept a low profile recently, paired the patterned design with black accessories. She maintains an eye for vintage finds.

stories.title: Pia Wurtzbach wears Gucci at Vogue Arabia Ball
stories.summary: Pia Wurtzbach attended the Vogue Arabia Ball 2026 wearing a cobalt-blue Gucci creation paired with Bvlgari jewelry. The model, who starred in the event's campaign, described the look as wearable art. The ball was dedicated to celebrating art through the female gaze.

stories.title: GUESS USA releases Winter 2026 collection
stories.summary: GUESS USA has launched its Winter 2026 collection, featuring distressed denim and leather. The brand says the line is a love letter to vintage Americana and leans into the current consumer obsession with Y2K vibes. The clothes are designed to feel relaxed, unpolished and free in expression.

stories.title: Atıl Kutoğlu visits Cairo Fashion Week
stories.summary: Turkish designer Atıl Kutoğlu participated in Cairo Fashion Week during an event hosted by the Turkish Embassy. Ambassador Salih Mutlu Şen stated that fashion can encourage cultural exchange and promote understanding between nations. The visit was intended to strengthen ties through design.

stories.title: Prada opens Pradasphere exhibition in Milan
stories.summary: Prada has opened a permanent exhibition titled Pradasphere in the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele in Milan. The display offers a look into the history and evolution of the Italian fashion house. Marketing Director Lorenzo Bertelli stated the exhibition provides a deep dive into the brand's craftsmanship.

stories.title: Archive photos highlight Willi Smith designs
stories.summary: Archival images show model Toukie Smith wearing designs by her brother, Willi Smith, during runway shows in the 1970s and 1980s. The collection documents various presentations, including bridal ensembles and junior sportswear. The images capture a period of American fashion history.

stories.title: Model Toukie Smith dies at 74
stories.summary: Doris Toukie Smith, a model and actress who helped broaden fashion’s vision of beauty, has died at age 74. She was the sister of designer Willi Smith and gained prominence after appearing in his runway shows. Her influence on the industry remains part of fashion’s story.

stories.title: MoMA and Chanel host film benefit for Steven Spielberg
stories.summary: The Museum of Modern Art held its 18th annual Film Benefit on Thursday to honor Steven Spielberg. The evening featured a montage of the director’s filmography, including Jaws and Jurassic Park, alongside unscripted moments from attendees like Jeff Goldblum and Martin Short. The event celebrated the power of cinema.

stories.title: Gold prices decline in Pakistan
stories.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan dropped on Friday, with 24-karat gold falling by Rs4,900 per tola to Rs411,636. International prices also decreased by $49 per ounce to $3,891. The decline provides relief to families purchasing jewellery for weddings, though the market remains sensitive to global bullion fluctuations.

stories.title: India gem and jewellery exports rise 34 percent
stories.summary: India’s gem and jewellery exports reached $2.92 billion in October 2026, a 34.01 percent increase year-on-year. The Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council attributed the growth to overseas demand for year-end celebrations and consistent production. Gold jewellery exports led the surge, rising 48.20 percent compared to last year.

stories.title: Senco Gold reports 71 percent profit increase
stories.summary: Jewellery retailer Senco Gold reported a 71 percent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to ₹83.5 crore for the second quarter of FY27. Revenue grew 34 percent to ₹2,058.7 crore. The company cited robust demand and retail expansion as primary drivers despite the impact of elevated gold prices.

stories.title: Limelight Lab Grown Diamonds reaches 100-store milestone across 45 cities in India - The Retail Jeweller India
So/Facet raises Rs 10 crore seed funding to build premium LGD jewellery retail brand - The Retail Jeweller India
Mouawad unveils Olive Crown jewellery collection
stories.summary: Mouawad has launched Olive Crown, a collection inspired by the symbolism of the olive tree. The suite includes high and fine jewellery pieces intended to explore themes of family heritage and resilience. The brand says the collection reflects the history of the family-owned house, which spans multiple generations.

stories.title: Bulgari hosts event at Palm Beach estate
stories.summary: Bulgari celebrated its new collection with an event at a waterfront Palm Beach estate designed by architect Addison Mizner. Guests including Venus Williams and Chanel Iman gathered at the pavilion to mark the launch. The brand continues to associate its high jewellery with the history of the region.

stories.title: Tiffany and CFDA name design award finalists
stories.summary: Tiffany and Co. and the CFDA have selected five finalists for their second annual jewelry designer award. The group will participate in a design challenge inspired by the jeweler’s legacy. The program offers mentorship and an immersive learning experience with the brand’s design team to advance their creative practice.

stories.title: Maison Marcelle launches Équation bracelet
stories.summary: Maison Marcelle’s Équation bracelet features 24 gold modules designed to mimic the feel of fabric. Designer Hadida, who transitioned from fashion to fine jewellery in 2025, named the brand after her grandmother. The piece launched at Couture earlier this year and is intended to flow around the wrist.

stories.title: Miss Universe unveils 2026 crown
stories.summary: The Miss Universe Organization unveiled its new crown, The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy, on November 12, 2026. The piece features 3,150 diamonds set in 18-karat white gold. It was created to commemorate the pageant’s 75th anniversary and will be used during the upcoming 2026 competition.

stories.title: Romanov sapphire sells for $4.9 million
stories.summary: A 197-carat sapphire once worn by Empress Maria Feodorovna sold for $4.9 million at a Sotheby’s auction this week. The stone, now set in a Cartier bracelet, was estimated to reach up to $2 million. It was previously owned by socialite Ganna Walska after the Russian Revolution.

stories.title: Britney Spears launches teaser site for jewellery line
stories.summary: Britney Spears has launched a teaser website for her jewellery brand, BTiny. The site invites fans to sign up for updates on the project, which the singer first mentioned in a 2003 interview. The brand is described as featuring delicate, intricate, and one-of-a-kind pieces.

stories.title: Britney Spears confirms jewellery brand BTiny
stories.summary: Britney Spears launched a website for her jewellery line, BTiny, on Friday. The singer has been developing the project for the past year, describing it as a top-secret venture. No images of the collection have been released, and fans are currently being directed to a waitlist for updates.

stories.title: Britney Spears Launches Website for Her BTiny Jewelry Brand, Teases Project 23 Years in the Making - IMDb
Britney Spears reveals BTiny jewellery venture
stories.summary: Britney Spears has launched a website for her jewellery line, BTiny, following reports of a secret business venture. A source confirmed the singer spent the past year working on the collection. No designs have been revealed, and the site is currently collecting sign-ups for a future announcement.

stories.title: Britney Spears involved in design of BTiny line
stories.summary: Britney Spears is preparing to launch her jewellery line, BTiny, in the coming months. Sources state the singer is personally leading the design process and approving all pieces. The brand is described as reflective of her personal style, with an Instagram account already live for the project.

stories.title: These celebrities are making a compelling case for tanzanite jewellery - Prestige Online - Singapore
Watchmakers gather for awards and new releases
stories.summary: The 2026 Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève saw Louis Vuitton win the Artistic Crafts Prize, while Vacheron Constantin, Casio, and Zenith debuted new models. Takashi Murakami also entered the fine watchmaking space with a skull-shaped design. The industry remains busy with collaborations and sculptural mechanics.

stories.title: Dress watches see a surge in search interest
stories.summary: Despite the ubiquity of smartphones, interest in traditional dress watches is rising. eBay's Watchlist Trend Report notes a significant increase in searches for iconic models, including a jump for the Rolex 1908. Apparently, the need to check the time has not been entirely replaced by the screen.

stories.title: Bulgari debuts Eclettica collection in Palm Beach
stories.summary: Bulgari hosted a gala at a historic Palm Beach estate to launch its Eclettica high jewelry collection. The event featured a model presentation and a big band, mimicking the atmosphere of a 1920s ball. Guests included Venus Williams and Chanel Iman. The jewelry was the evening's primary focus.

stories.title: Bangladesh’s share of global apparel exports doubles to 10.9pc - New Age BD
Apparel exports rise as rupee value falls
stories.summary: India's apparel exports grew 20.33 percent in October 2026, largely driven by currency depreciation rather than increased shipment volumes. Exporters report strong demand but note that expansion projects have not yet translated into higher output. The sector is currently prioritizing value over volume.

stories.title: Government seeks wider markets for Kutch artisans
stories.summary: Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh announced plans to expand global market access for Kutch artisans and traditional crafts. The government aims to integrate traditional techniques like Ajrakh block printing with contemporary designs. Officials describe these artisans as the custodians of India's cultural heritage.

stories.title: Mohan Spintex plans new terry towel facility
stories.summary: Mohan Spintex India Limited has signed an agreement to build an integrated terry towel plant in Andhra Pradesh. The company plans to invest 729 crore rupees in the facility, which is expected to process 80 tonnes of material daily and create 1,500 jobs.

stories.title: Students explore sustainable fashion at youth conference
stories.summary: Marr College pupils attended the Future Textiles Youth Conference at Dumfries House to discuss sustainable fashion. The event, hosted by The Kings Foundation and Fashion Council Germany, focused on repair and upcycling. Students shared perspectives on their role in shaping the future of the industry.

stories.title: EU reports 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste
stories.summary: Eurostat data indicates the EU generated 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste in 2024. Member states treated 63 percent of this total, with Italy recording the highest volumes for both generation and treatment. Recovery operations accounted for 91 percent of all treated textile waste.

stories.title: Lagos Fashion Week highlights African craftsmanship
stories.summary: The 16th Lagos Fashion Week concluded on November 1, focusing on indigenous textiles and sustainable production. The event, themed around heritage and circular futures, featured runway shows and industry discussions. Designers showcased collections intended to preserve traditional craftsmanship while exploring modern, circular approaches to fashion.

First Native fashion and film festival set for Nov. 21 - CW33.com
Choctaw Landing to host Native Fashion and Film Festival
stories.summary: Choctaw Landing will host its inaugural Native Fashion and Film Festival on November 21. The event features a fashion show, film screenings, and traditional performances to celebrate Native American culture. The festivities are scheduled to run from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. on the property's Cypress Lawn.

stories.title: Fashion industry continues to navigate indigenous design
stories.summary: A former fast-fashion designer notes the blurred line between inspiration and appropriation in the industry. The practice of sourcing samples from retail hubs for mass production remains common, often leaving originators without credit or compensation. Inspiration is frequently treated as a free resource for the design room.

stories.title: Emma Watson wears biodegradable gown to LACMA gala
stories.summary: Emma Watson attended the 2026 LACMA Art and Film Gala wearing a corseted gown designed by Caroline Zimbalist. The garment, constructed by Rae Moore Studio, features two thigh-high slits and is made entirely of biodegradable textiles. Sustainability is now a red carpet requirement.

stories.title: A.W.A.K.E. Mode Founder Natalia Alaverdian Exits as Creative Director - The Business of Fashion
Filatex India revenue grows 21 percent in second quarter
stories.summary: Filatex India reported a 21.22 percent year-on-year revenue increase to 1,304.19 crore rupees for the quarter ending September 30. While revenue grew, the company's EBITDA margin declined to 6.9 percent. Improved business performance did not entirely shield the manufacturer from margin pressure.

stories.title: Dollar Industries reports revenue growth as quick commerce expands
stories.summary: Dollar Industries reported a 14.3 percent revenue increase to 539.28 crore rupees, with quick commerce sales growing 58.5 percent. Higher cotton prices weighed on gross margins, leaving operating EBITDA nearly flat at 60.54 crore rupees. Growth in distribution channels is currently offsetting rising material costs.

stories.title: Cantabil Retail reports revenue and margin growth
stories.summary: Cantabil Retail India reported an 11 percent revenue increase to 370.5 crore rupees for the first half of the fiscal year. The company cited cost management and sourcing efficiencies for an EBITDA margin of 28 percent. Profit after tax rose to 23.4 crore rupees during the period.

stories.title: India gem and jewellery exports surge in October
stories.summary: India's gem and jewellery exports grew 34.01 percent year-on-year to 2.92 billion dollars in October 2026. The Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council attributed the performance to international holiday orders. A favourable base effect also contributed to the monthly growth figures.

stories.title: This Week in Retail: Burberry Lifts Adjusted Profit to £62 Million, Zara Home Opens in Ireland, Moncler Opens Singapore
Jewellery manufacturers seek capital as demand rises
stories.summary: At least 10 mid-sized jewellery companies have filed initial papers to go public in the last two months. Seven of the firms are B2B manufacturers specializing in gold and diamond products. The industry is currently attempting to capitalize on a period of high gold prices and demand.

stories.title: Richemont stock falls as luxury jewellery sales slow
stories.summary: Richemont shares dropped 4 percent after the company reported 14 percent sales growth in its jewellery division, missing analyst expectations of 16 percent. While net profit rose to 2.5 billion euros, the luxury sector continues to struggle with cost-sensitive consumers and rising gold prices.

stories.title: Silver demand expected to decline in 2026
stories.summary: Global silver demand is forecast to fall 5 percent this year, with jewellery demand dropping 22 percent. Metals Focus research suggests buyers are moving away from the metal as prices remain volatile. Silver is currently leaning on industrial sectors like solar and electronics to maintain market relevance.

stories.title: Lenskart makes blue-light lenses standard
stories.summary: Lenskart announced that blue-light filtering lenses will now be standard on eligible eyewear at no extra cost. The company also plans to provide free prescription glasses to 100,000 children for Children's Day. The announcement coincides with the one-year anniversary of the company's stock market listing.

stories.title: EBay hosts luxury resale shopping streams
stories.summary: EBay is launching a six-day series of luxury resale livestreams featuring archival fashion and designer handbags. The event aims to connect shoppers with high-demand pieces identified in the company's 2026 fall Watchlist. The secondhand market is being positioned as a primary destination for holiday gifting.

stories.title: Dressx expands fashion AI suite for ecommerce
stories.summary: Dressx offers an AI suite for ecommerce brands, featuring virtual try-on tools and personalized AI twins. The company provides modular services including size recommendations and automated product imagery. Monthly subscription plans for the studio tools range from 29 dollars to 249 dollars.

stories.title: Guide offers prompts for AI face analysis
stories.summary: A new guide provides eight text prompts for users to paste into AI chatbots after uploading selfies. The instructions direct the AI to analyze facial features and suggest makeup or accessory styles. Beauty brands are reportedly monitoring these tools to see how consumers interact with automated aesthetic advice.

stories.title: ChatGPT beauty reports gain traction on social media
stories.summary: AI-generated beauty reports that rate facial symmetry and proportions have become popular on TikTok and Instagram. The process involves uploading a selfie to a chatbot to receive a numerical score and style recommendations. The accuracy of these automated assessments remains a subject of ongoing user interest.

stories.title: Red light therapy panels move from the bathroom to the living room
stories.summary: Beauty technology is officially outgrowing the bathroom cabinet. While LED face masks are a skin care status symbol, red light therapy panels are now being marketed as larger devices for the body. The technology uses specific wavelengths of light to influence cells, according to WWD editors.

stories.title: CMAI and NIFT VisioNxt partner on fashion forecasting
stories.summary: The Clothing Manufacturers Association of India and NIFT VisioNxt signed a memorandum of understanding on 12 November 2026. The partnership aims to bring research-driven fashion intelligence and AI-led design capabilities to the Indian apparel industry. The organisations intend to strengthen knowledge exchange and professional capabilities across key hubs.

stories.title: Adie Broswon Group expands Mark V whisky in North India
stories.summary: The Adie Broswon Group has launched its Mark V whisky in Chandigarh and Uttarakhand. The brand, which blends Indian grain spirits with Scottish Vatted Malt Spirit, positions itself using themes of courage and valour. The expansion follows a 2025 debut in Delhi as the group targets the IMFL market.

stories.title: Olive Young to open San Diego store
stories.summary: Korean beauty retailer Olive Young plans to open a location at Fashion Valley in San Diego by mid-2027. The store is part of a broader U.S. expansion that includes five additional California locations by the first half of 2027. The brand is known for its curated K-beauty assortment.

stories.title: Istituto Marangoni Riyadh launches talent contest
stories.summary: Istituto Marangoni Riyadh has introduced a Made for Fashion contest for applicants to its diploma and certificate programs. The school aims to identify creative talent as Saudi Arabia works to establish itself as a dynamic creative market under Vision 2030. The contest invites students to showcase their aesthetic vision.

stories.title: Texas A&M students host fashion show
stories.summary: A-Line Magazine, a student-led publication at Texas A&M University, will host its Fall 2026 fashion show on 13 November at Rountree Market. The event features runway looks created by student stylists alongside local vendors. The magazine is presenting its latest editorial world, titled VISCERA, to the public.

stories.title: Edessa School of Fashion markets low-cost tuition
stories.summary: Edessa School of Fashion is promoting its $100 per credit hour tuition as an accessible alternative to programs costing $39,000 annually. The school employs faculty with experience at major retailers like Gap and Walmart. It claims to connect the classroom directly to the industry through professional networks.

stories.title: MIAD students design for people with disabilities
MICA faculty member discusses fashion as communication
stories.summary: Hope Simpara, faculty in MICA’s Fiber, Fashion, and Textile program, argues that clothing serves as a tool for communication, identity, and protest. Her professional background spans technical design and automotive interiors. She views the process of making fashion as a way to provide students with versatile, expansive skill sets.

stories.title: People’s Arc of Suffolk fashion show raises funds
stories.summary: People’s Arc of Suffolk raised over $5,000 during its 21st annual fashion show on 11 November. The event featured two dozen participants with intellectual and developmental disabilities modeling their own clothing choices. The nonprofit provides residential and educational services to Long Island residents.

stories.title: Supima Design Competition showcases student collections
stories.summary: The 2026 Supima Design Competition gathered finalists from six U.S. fashion schools at Lavan Studios in Manhattan. Sponsored by a nonprofit promoting Pima cotton, the event requires students to create original collections for industry professionals. The competition serves as a platform to spotlight rising talent in luxury fashion.

stories.title: Luly Yang debuts collection at Fairmont Olympic Hotel
stories.summary: Designer Luly Yang showcased her METAMORPHOSIS: SECOND NATURE collection at the Fairmont Olympic Hotel on 5 November. The designer plans to house the collection at her new Kirkland space, The Monarch. The location will also feature home goods and customizable pet items alongside her couture designs.

stories.title: TUMI opens store at Hyderabad Airport
stories.summary: TUMI has opened a retail location at Hyderabad International Airport. The brand, a subsidiary of Samsonite, operates in India through an exclusive partnership with Reliance Brands Limited. The store offers travel essentials and luxury goods to airport travellers as part of the company's retail expansion.
